PILLAR TO POST FROM
A WORLD CLASS TRANSPORT SYSTEM

THOMSON MRT STATION
1) I visited Thomson MRT Station at about 3.00pm to request a printout of my transaction for the transport voucher 2024, which was redeemed in December 2024.

BISHAN MRT STATION

6) I was baffled to find out that Bishan MRT Ticketing office was closed at 3.40pm.

ANG MO KIO MRT STATION
9) I met Ms Zhao Xiaohang from Ang Mo Kio MRT Ticketing Office.

10) Ms Zhao mentioned that she waa NOT able to print any previous transaction history as there was NO PRINTER in the ticketing office!  There was also no previous transaction records!

11) I will need to call the MRT hotline for further assistance!

3 DIFFERENT MRT STATIONS
12) A 61 year old lady was asked to go to 3 different MRT stations to have her transaction printout!

WORLD CLASS TRANSPORT SYSTEM
13) Singapore calls herself a World Class Transport System.

Regards
Dr Mary Baker
